title: The Impact of Treatments for Depression on the Dynamic Network Structure of Mental States: Two Randomized Controlled Trials
sample_size: Imipramine trial: 50 participants; Mind-Maastricht trial: 119 participants
limitations: - Small sample size in the Imipramine trial (n=50); - Lack of follow-up ESM assessments to examine long-term changes; - Data on medication adherence was not available; - Future studies could consider including a broader variety of positive emotions.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. The authors mention using permutation testing procedures for statistical analysis, which is a methodological strength. The code for the analyses is declared available, but the dataset is not explicitly stated as publicly available. The paper was published in Scientific Reports, which may have different data sharing policies.
